items.value: Length: about 7.25 inch, with strong elastic string. Small bead size is 3mm in diameter. Large bead size is 6mm in diameter. The stretch gold bead bracelet is elastic and suitable for wearing on various wrists, making you elegant and sexy every moment.

items.label: Superior Material
items.value: These dainty gold bracelets stack are made of high-quality copper, 14k gold plated bracelet stack, hypoallergenic, lead-free, and nickel free. it is not easy to fade and can maintain its luster for a long time. It's very comfortable to wear. It is an excellent choice for people with very sensitive skin.

items.label: Perfect Gifts
items.value: Give it to the person you love most to remind him/her of your love. The gold stackable bracelet set comes with a beautiful gift bag. It is highly recommended as a gift for your wife, mother, father and friends on Mother's Day, Father’s Day, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas and Birthday.
